text: Survey checklist: the 'Hole in the roof (stand under it, look up)' line is drawn in a smaller font than the other items, apparently shrunk to fit. Also 'Grime' was ticked at tick ~168 just from standing at spawn facing the cabin wall.

Help panel (shown by default) covers the whole lower third of the screen, which is exactly where the floor, debris and snow drift are when you tilt down to survey/work. A first-time player has to discover F1 to see what they're aiming at.

Shovel did nothing for 4s of mouse hold with the crosshair visibly on the snow drift's edge, because a fallen shingle lying on the drift took the aim ('Fallen shingle - Haul it out'). Only after nudging the crosshair onto bare snow did shoveling start. Contradicts 'the shovel works anywhere on the drift's full footprint'. Tick ~3450-3800, player at (0.8,0.4) yaw 297 pitch -45.

Pressing E next to the Fallen rafter (0.7m away, walkto debris picked it as nearest debris) says 'Nothing to pick up there.' A new player who wants to haul the rafter gets no hint that it must be sawn first; the saw hint only shows if the crosshair is exactly on the rafter. Expected: 'Too long to carry - saw it (4)' when E is pressed near it.

Indoors at 1:01 pm (window still boarded) the cabin is almost black at floor level; while sweeping I could not see which floorboards were still dirty, only the 'Clean here. Move on.' text. Sweeping by feel at ~10% per 30 game seconds; 'Sweep the floor' on screen is 53% while probe floorClean is 0.45 (screen shows progress toward a threshold, not cleanliness).

Checklist text (white/grey, no backing panel or outline) becomes hard to read over the freshly scrubbed pale chimney stones: 'Scrub the walls (13%)' is nearly illegible. Same issue earlier over the snow drift. Tick ~25180.
